# Polygenic overlap when one trait is oligogenic

*Generated by `report.py` from `results/estimates.csv`. Do not edit by hand.*

bipred 0.3.6, ldpred3 0.4.5, numpy 2.4.6 on Windows-11-10.0.26200-SP0. Arm 001: lenient per-variant QC, long-range LD retained, LD-consistency screen on.

## Finding

For lipoprotein(a) against coronary artery disease, genome-wide `rg` is +0.0481 -- indistinguishable from noise -- and cross-trait LDSC puts it at -0.0945 (se 0.1161), pointing the wrong way. The same fit estimates **106 causal variants** for Lp(a) against 1,459 for CAD, 46% of them shared, with effects correlating **+0.3644**.

Averaging one very large locus over a million variants destroys the signal. The architecture summary does not average it away.

| cystatinC x CRP | **+0.3362** | 0.7620 | +0.2321 | +0.3546 |
| ALP x GGT | **+0.2842** | 0.7969 | +0.2040 | +0.3292 |
| Lp(a) x VTE | **-0.0424** | 0.4205 | -0.0001 | +0.0287 |
| GGT x bilirubin | **-0.0545** | 0.6347 | -0.0320 | -0.1170 |
| SHBG x ALP | **-0.0607** | 0.7115 | -0.0464 | -0.1147 |
| CRP x Lp(a) | **-0.1137** | 0.3877 | -0.0009 | +0.0587 |

The top of the range is set by two pairs where the answer was known in advance: direct against total bilirubin (two studies of the same biology) and urate against gout (crystals are the disease mechanism). Both land near +0.99. The bottom is set by three pairs with no expected shared biology, which fall between -0.11 and -0.05. Lp(a) x CAD sits at +0.3644, with the related pairs rather than with the null.

**`frac_shared` is not the informative statistic.** Unrelated polygenic pairs still share 63-80% of their causal variants; for polygenic traits that is the default. The direction correlation is what discriminates.

## Caveats

- **`rg` +0.0481 for Lp(a) x CAD is not a null result**, and will be read as one if quoted without the architecture explanation.

- **Lp(a)'s h2 of 0.007 is a reference limitation.** HapMap3 tags the LPA KIV-2 repeat poorly; it is not an estimate of Lp(a) heritability.

- **Lp(a) is a 4-cohort meta at 95.9% European** against a European LD reference. The European-only alternative covered 16% and was unusable.

- **The Sinnott-Armstrong panel publishes no allele frequency**, so the AF-concordance check is vacuous for those traits and their `af corr` of +1.0000 is an artifact. See `_lib/datasets.md`.

- **Sample overlap is substantial** -- most exposures are UK Biobank. The cross-trait intercept absorbs it and is recorded per pair.

- **The overlap statistics carry no interval**, so the null band is descriptive, not a test. Largest gap in this analysis.

- **One pair was rejected on data grounds**, not results: bilirubin x gallstones. `_lib/datasets.md` records why.
